inspection.title: Gateway Arch Historic Structure Report, Volume I (NPS, 2010)
inspection.notes: Rendered section/photograph pages and the NPS equation image were inspected. Publication pixels are not redistributed.

limitations: Maximum fidelity remains pending: exact fabrication station spacing, weld treatments, window dimensions/offsets, service hatch and leg exits, base apron and current museum interface. NPS fact-sheet window width and segment count differ from the historic report; those discrepancies are explicit in the recipe. The exact-QID OSM node 4004558403 corroborates the approximate center, but supplies no leg coordinates or axis. The native north/south axis is an approximation from the NPS descriptions. Surveyed leg centers, actual azimuth, apron and terrain datum remain pending; the preview placement is not activated.
